text_block_list.text:
What?! Dang it! Have they come
already?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The Sandmen must be launching their
attack!
They knock people dead asleep
and take over
their bodies!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I've been fighting them off in secret all
this time...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Ngh... But it seems my time has come.
The fate of
the world is in your hands
now, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
With that, Голд Шипп lies down on the
sofa in the
trainer's office.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And in seconds, she's out like a light. I
can't
comment on the Sandmen invasion,
but Голд Шип
definitely needs more
sleЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог
